title: Stripe (REST API, restricted key with Webhook Endpoints: Read)
readScopes: A restricted API key (rk_live_...) whose only permission is Webhook Endpoints: Read (Dashboard > Developers > API keys > Create restricted key). A secret key (sk_...) is refused.

checks.title: Every enabled Stripe webhook endpoint receives events over HTTPS
checks.scope: The enabled webhook endpoints of the account (or sandbox) the restricted key belongs to; whether the receiver checks the Stripe-Signature header is not visible.

checks.title: No enabled Stripe webhook endpoint subscribes to every event
checks.scope: enabled_events of each enabled endpoint; '*' (all events, per Stripe's API reference) fails. Which events an endpoint truly needs is not judged.
